svg.aria-label: Isometric drawing of a design studio table where a Tcules team and the client's team decide what to build before it is built. In the middle of the table lies the product as a dashed outline with three empty bays; a Tcules designer sets a lime block, the piece to build first, into the first bay, while a pale dashed block waits in the second and the third stays empty. At the left, a real user taps a blue prototype phone and answers with a tick, a Tcules researcher pins the ticked note to a board of test notes, and a paper sketch of the screen lies on the table. At the right, the client's product lead works at a laptop showing the design, and a dotted line runs from the screen's button to the tallest of three rising bars. A notebook and a mug sit on the table.
